content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user of the to-do list","i_want":"to mark a task as Completed and revert a Completed task back to Open","so_that":"I can track which tasks are done and reopen any that need more work","business_description":"Users change the Status of a task between Open and Completed. When a task is marked Completed, its Completion Date is set. The Status field and its allowed values (Open, In Progress, Completed) are created by US-create-task and are not repeated here.","business_value":"Users can see which work is finished and correct mistakes by reopening tasks, which feeds the Completed and Open counts in the task report.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with Status Open","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores Status Completed and sets the Completion Date to the current date, and the frontend shows Completed only after the backend confirms success"},{"given":"a task with Status Completed","when":"the user reverts the task to Open","then":"the backend stores Status Open and the frontend shows Open only after the backend confirms success"},{"given":"the backend status change fails (for example, the task does not exist or a database error occurs)","when":"the user marks the task as Completed or reverts it to Open","then":"the frontend keeps the previous status shown and displays an error message"},{"given":"a task that has just been marked Completed","when":"the Completion Date is read back from the backend","then":"it holds the date on which the task was marked Completed"}],"edge_cases":["The task is already Completed and the user marks it Completed again: the PRD does not say whether this is a no-op or an error. Open question.","The task is Open and the user reverts it to Open: the PRD does not say whether this is a no-op or an error. Open question.","The task is In Progress: the PRD does not state whether it can be marked Completed directly. Open question.","When a Completed task is reverted to Open, the PRD does not say whether the Completion Date is cleared or kept. Open question.","The status change targets a task ID that does not exist: the backend returns the task-not-found error defined by US-create-task."],"dependencies":["US-create-task","US-view-task-list"],"definition_of_done":["The tasks table has a Completion Date column that accepts a date value and allows no value for tasks that are not completed.","Marking a task Completed sets Status to Completed and Completion Date to the current date in the backend.","Reverting a task sets Status to Open; the handling of Completion Date follows the decision recorded in the open questions.","The frontend shows the new status only after the backend returns success, and shows an error message when the backend fails.","Automated tests cover mark completed, revert to open, the Completion Date value, and the failure path, and all pass."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"tasks-completion-date-column","title":"[BE] Add Completion Date column to the tasks table","track":"backend","area":"db","description":"Add a nullable Completion Date column to the tasks table created by US-create-task. The displayed status changes only after the backend confirms success.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-2304218f","R-959e2960","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["The control shows the action that matches the current status: mark Completed for Open tasks, revert to Open for Completed tasks.","The displayed status does not change until the backend returns success.","When the backend returns an error, the previous status stays shown and an error message is displayed.","The task list refreshes after a successful status change."]},{"key_slug":"task-status-change-test-suite","title":"[QA] Test suite for marking tasks Completed and reverting to Open","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"End-to-end and API tests for the status change flow: mark Completed, revert to Open, Completion Date handling, and failure behaviour in the UI.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-2304218f","R-959e2960","R-34e41747","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Tests cover marking Open to Completed and Completed to Open.","Tests check that Completion Date is set on completion.","Tests check that the UI does not show Completed when the backend call fails.","All tests pass in the CI pipeline."]}]}
